author: Inquire II
title: Debug Trust-Constr Method String for KKT Extraction (Inquire II)
abstract: This submission aims to debug the 'trust-constr' method string comparison issue encountered during KKT multiplier extraction. Additional print statements have been added to `construct_packing` to inspect the exact value and type of `res.method` after the optimization. The goal is to identify why `res.method != 'trust-constr'` is evaluating to True when `trust-constr` is explicitly used, blocking KKT extraction.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, NonlinearConstraint
import sys
import pandas as pd # For KKT DataFrame output

# Append lineage storage path to sys.path to import custom modules
sys.path.append('storage/inquire/circle_packing')

from slsqp_utils import pack_to_z, z_to_pack, objective
from config import N_CIRCLES, TRUST_CONSTR_OPTIONS, BOUNDS, CONSTRAINTS_FOR_TRUST_CONSTR, SAFETY_FACTOR
from kkt_analysis import get_inquire_207_sota_trust_constr_run, extract_kkt_multipliers

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    print("--- Starting Debugging Trust-Constr Method String for KKT Extraction ---", file=sys.stdout)
    
    res = get_inquire_207_sota_trust_constr_run(N_circles=N_CIRCLES)
    
    # Debugging print statements
    print(f"DEBUG: Type of res: {type(res)}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"DEBUG: Value of res.method: '{res.method}'", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"DEBUG: Is res.method == 'trust-constr'?: {res.method == 'trust-constr'}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"DEBUG: Is res.method.strip() == 'trust-constr'?: {res.method.strip() == 'trust-constr'}", file=sys.stdout)
    
    # Extract final centers and radii
    final_centers, final_radii = z_to_pack(res.x)
    final_radii *= SAFETY_FACTOR
    score = np.sum(final_radii)
    
    print(f"\nTrust-Constr Optimization Success: {res.success}, Message: {res.message}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Trust-Constr Optimized Score: {score:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)
    
    # Extract and print top KKT multipliers for verification
    try:
        df_multipliers = extract_kkt_multipliers(res, N=N_CIRCLES)
        print("\n--- Top KKT Multipliers (first 5) ---", file=sys.stdout)
        print(df_multipliers.head().to_string(), file=sys.stdout)
        print(f"Total active constraints identified (shadow_price > tol and slack_value approx 0): {df_multipliers['is_active'].sum()}", file=sys.stdout)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error extracting KKT multipliers: {e}", file=sys.stdout)

    print("\n--- Debugging Trust-Constr Method String for KKT Extraction Complete ---", file=sys.stdout)
    return final_centers, final_radii
